schedule_inductor_kernel: schedule and fuse GPU kernels in PyTorch Inductor by analyzing node dependencies and generating optimized execution order
fuse_scheduler_nodes: fuse scheduler nodes together to reduce memory traffic and improve GPU kernel performance
check_fusion_legal: check whether two scheduler nodes can be legally fused without violating dependency constraints
generate_kernel_code: generate CUDA/triton kernel code from a scheduled and fused set of Inductor scheduler nodes
estimate_kernel_runtime: estimate the runtime in nanoseconds for a scheduler node based on memory bandwidth and compute throughput
